title: Unsupervised Learning
motto: No labels, no teacher. The algorithm finds structure on its own.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: No labels, no teacher. The algorithm finds structure on its own.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: Every ML lesson so far has assumed labeled data: "here is an input, here is the correct output." In the real world, labels are expensive. A hospital has millions of patient records but no one has manually tagged each one with a disease category. An e-commerce site has millions of user sessions but no one has hand-labeled customer segments. A security team has network logs but nobody has flagged every anomaly.

Unsupervised learning finds patterns without being told what to look for. It groups similar data points, discovers hidden structures, and surfaces anomalies. If supervised learning is learning from a textbook with an answer key, unsupervised learning is staring at raw data until the patterns reveal themselves.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: K-means clusters points by iterative assignment and centroid update. Unsupervised = no labels.
